font_basis: Cormorant Garamond, variable weight 500; regular e/o/r with an adapted italic l
license: SIL Open Font License 1.1; copy in fonts/OFL.txt
modifications: Optical spacing between all four glyphs
Slight organic rise on e crossbar and o contour
Shortened, more upright italic l with curved foot
Custom grave accent sized to remain legible in headers
Horizontal optical expansion and tight transparent viewBox
Favicon uses the same e/grave with slight stroke reinforcement
limitations: A font-based vector interpretation of the approved image-generated Gesture sketch, not an exact trace. The l, e, and r terminal details differ slightly. All output shapes are editable vector paths; no raster tracing artifacts.
